title: Docsite usage journeys and token ecosystem: updated examples, do/don't and API surface
creator: Avery Kim
description: Background: Our design docs site currently has fragmented guidance for tokens and components (buttons, tables, charts). Engineers and product teams report inconsistent token usage and repeated design regressions after model rollouts. This ticket centralizes a fresh "usage journeys" section on the docs site that ties token decisions to concrete component examples, migration notes, and a clear component API surface for engineering.
goal: Create a concise, example-driven set of docsite pages that: 1) teach teams how to think about the token ecosystem (semantic tokens, scales, theming), 2) show concrete do/don't examples for buttons, tables, charts, and 3) define a minimal API reference for each component including accessibility and migration guidance.
scope: Update docsite pages under /tokens, /components/buttons, /components/tables, /components/charts. Add a new top-level 'usage journeys' landing that maps common product scenarios (settings pages, data-heavy dashboards, dense forms) to recommended token and component patterns. Include a migration appendix for older token names and legacy props.
out_of_scope: Complete rework of component implementation or API changes that require runtime deprecations. Large design token renames where backend migrations are required (handled separately).
deliverables: New 'Usage Journeys' landing page with scenario-to-pattern map
Token Ecosystem guide: semantic tokens, scales, theming, when to use semantic vs. raw tokens
Buttons page: primary/secondary/ghost variants with do/don't, code snippets, accessibility checklist
Tables page: density variants, sticky headers, row actions, performance notes for large datasets
Charts page: color token guidance, contrast rules, legend and annotation patterns
Migration appendix: mapping table for legacy tokens (oldToken -> newSemanticToken) and common prop deprecations
Concise component API reference snippets (props list + examples) for each component
acceptance_criteria: Pages published to staging docs and linked from main nav
At least three example-driven journeys per scenario (dashboard, form, settings) with live code snippets
Migration appendix includes mapping for >= 30 legacy tokens and a one-click snippet for codemods (examples) in the repo
Design review signoff from PM and Engineered by Miguel Torres and Heather Liu
Docs unit links to sample PRs and a small integration smoke test verifying CSS token outputs
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Developers may rely on legacy token names — Mitigation: publish codemod examples and add deprecation banners in the old token docs
Risk: Accessibility regressions from chart color guidance — Mitigation: include WCAG contrast checks and automated tests for color palettes
Risk: Scope creep from wanting API changes — Mitigation: lock to doc updates only; issue new tickets for any implementation changes
workplan: Week 1: author drafts for 'Token Ecosystem' and 'Usage Journeys' + gather existing examples. Week 2: implement component pages with do/don't screenshots and code snippets; run accessibility checks. Week 3: iterate with engineering feedback, publish to staging, and add migration codemod samples.
notes: Prefer short runnable React + CSS token snippets. Use Storybook links for live playgrounds. For charts, provide both color token and semantic color examples and include a short JS utility to validate contrast.
